elements.text: How to print with three inks
Warm and loud. Lay it down first so the other inks can sit on top of it.
The lightest ink. Under blue it turns green, under pink it turns orange.
Cool and deep. Use it for the line work and the small text.
How to print with three inks
Pink over blue is purple. Yellow over blue is green.

Bring an apron and one drawing you do not mind losing.

elements.text: How to print with three inks

A sauce zine in
four small steps

1  Tomatoes, 1 kg
2  Olive oil, 4 spoons
3  Onion, one
4  Salt, basil

Cook slow, forty minutes,
until the pan goes quiet.
Taste. Salt. Taste again.

Cut it small.
The size of a lentil is fine, the size of a coin is not. Cry if you have to.
Warm the oil in the widest pan you own. Add the onion and a pinch of salt. Wait until it is the colour of a church candle.
Tear the tomatoes in with your hands. Lower the heat. Leave the lid off and go and do something else.
